name: LangChain / LangGraph
free_plan_limits: Libraries are free; LangSmith Developer is free for 1 seat, 5,000 traces a month
usage_note: Optional LangSmith Plus is $39 per seat a month
since_note: LangChain first released October 2022 (Wikipedia); LangGraph came later.
best_for: Developers building custom AI agents in code
notes: $0 is the MIT-licensed code. You pay your model provider separately. start_usd is the paid LangSmith monitoring service, which is optional.

name: CrewAI
free_plan_limits: Open-source library is free; hosted AMP free tier has 50 runs a month
since_note: First released 2023 on PyPI/GitHub (Wikipedia lists December 2023).
best_for: Teams of role-playing AI agents in Python
notes: MIT license, Python only. Hosted AMP platform has a free tier and a custom-price Enterprise tier; no middle paid plan found (pricing page was rate-limited, read via search snippet).

name: AutoGen
best_for: Reading old projects; new work should use its successor
notes: The repo is archived: no fixes or support. Microsoft says new users should start with Microsoft Agent Framework. Has Python and .NET versions; AutoGen Studio is a no-code prototype tool.

name: LlamaIndex
free_plan_limits: Library is free; LlamaParse cloud free plan has 10,000 credits a month
usage_note: Optional cloud Starter is $50 a month for 40,000 credits
since_note: First released November 2022 as GPT Index; renamed LlamaIndex 2023 (Wikipedia).
best_for: Connecting AI to your own documents
notes: MIT license. The company's focus has moved to its paid LlamaParse document service; the framework is kept as an open toolkit. Cloud prices from search snippet of its docs; overage rate differs by page.

name: Flowise
free_plan_limits: Self-hosting is free; cloud free plan limited to 2 flows
best_for: Drag-and-drop AI agents without much code
notes: The GitHub repo was archived on Aug 13, 2026, so check it is still maintained. Cloud Starter $35 and Pro $65 come from an older snapshot of its site; pricing page was rate-limited.

name: Google ADK
usage_note: You pay your model provider (for example Gemini) per use
since_note: Announced at Google Cloud Next, April 2025 (secondary sources; docs page was rate-limited).
best_for: Building agents that run on Google Cloud
notes: Apache 2.0. Also has Java and Go versions. Facts from search results about Google's developer blog, not the docs page itself. Model usage costs are extra.

name: Agno
free_plan_limits: Runtime is free and open source on every plan
usage_note: Optional Pro control plane is $150 a month, plus $95 per extra connection
best_for: Python multi-agent apps with built-in memory
notes: Apache 2.0. Serving agents costs nothing on any plan; only the hosted control plane is paid. Seat count on Pro differs between sources.

name: OpenAI Agents SDK
usage_note: You pay OpenAI per use for the models
since_note: Python repo created March 2025 (third-party report; docs page was rate-limited).
best_for: Simple agents that hand work to other agents
notes: MIT license for both Python and JavaScript versions, per search results. Model usage costs are extra. Not read from the docs page itself.

name: Claude Agent SDK
usage_note: You pay Anthropic per use for Claude models
since_note: Launched as the Claude Code SDK in 2025, later renamed Claude Agent SDK (Anthropic docs).
best_for: Agents built on Claude Code's tools
notes: Python and TypeScript packages, with subagents. Open-source status not stated: license terms page was not readable. Model usage costs are extra.
